cases.name: Riley Nicole O’Laughlin
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Riley graduated from Nixa High School before earning her degree as a graphic designer from Ozark Technical School. Riley moved to Kansas City, MO to pursue her graphic arts degree. She was employed at a non-profit organization where she loved her work and all the people she worked with.

While there, she came to know Jesus Christ and was baptized at Northland Church in Kansas City (where she was planning a missionary trip to Ecuador). Riley met people wherever she would go and they became her second family.

Riley would light up the room with her sweetness and positivity in any situation. Today we all have lost a great shining light and an inspiration for living life to the fullest."
